discipline_dismissal_002.evidence: A non-tenured teacher who has completed five consecutive years of satisfactory or better service has the right to file a grievance challenging the Board's decision not to renew his/her contract... a non-tenured teacher with less than 5 consecutive years... shall have the right to a hearing before a Board appointed referee... provided the teacher submits a written request to the Superintendent for such a hearing within 10 days of receiving written notice of the Superintendent's recommendation not to re-employ the teacher... The decision of the referee shall be in the form of a recommendation to the Board of Education.
